name: Custom Packaging Services
old_description: Our shrink wrapper crew specializes in shrink wrapping retail packages & products.
about:
Custom Packaging Services operates from Richmond, Virginia. The founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The company provides a range of packaging and logistics services, including custom corrugated box design and assembly, custom wooden crate and pallet manufacturing, shrink wrapping, shrink sleeving, registered bundling, foil and card blistering, RF clamshell packaging, point-of-purchase displays, package gluing, product repackaging, relabeling, package design, packout services, kitting and assembly, manual hand assembly, fulfillment, and warehousing. They manufacture custom wooden crates and pallets built to shipment specifications and specialize in shrink wrapping retail packages and products.

Custom Packaging Services partners with businesses to scale operations in production, storage, and handling or shipping. Their customer base includes retail brands and club-store suppliers; the company notes that stores such as Costco and Sam's Club maintain rigorous specifications for club-pack packaging, which they are equipped to meet.

The company emphasizes flexibility and reliability, promoting "Custom Orders • Low Minimums • Fast Turn-Around Times" and describing itself as "LARGE ENOUGH TO BE RELIABLE • SMALL ENOUGH TO BE FLEXIBLE." It cites production-line accuracy as a source of its reputation for excellence.
